exact_statement: For the original conditioned forest queue (gamma=6/5), N equal-width W signed conjunction gates, and fixed uniform lambda=1/N, if h original gates cover every relevant coordinate, each nonempty output A has a selected successful event of probability Q(A)>=2^(-1-h log2(N)-(5h-1)W); the actual whole-output probability Q_*(A)>=Q(A). In particular for F=2 A_r 1_{|x|>=m-t}1_{|y|>=m-t}-1 on disjoint uniform blocks, m>=2, r>=0 and 0<=t<=max(1,floor(m/4)), its unchanged full positive-prime table with N=binom(m,t)^2, W=2(m-t)+r and lambda=1/N has complete nonempty cross-entropy C_*<=96 I(F), and H(F)<=107 I(F). In the central-band extension m=2k,t=k,r=0 (k>=1), the same two-prime coordinate cover exists but (2m)Var(F)/I(F)>=(7/8)sqrt(k+1); this is an obstruction to uniform dimension-budget payment only, not a queue-cost or FEI lower bound.
